The '''Tenara system''' was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]], within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. A small [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] connected the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korphir]]. The Tenara system contained the planet [[Tenara]], on which, [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before<ref name="TEA" /> [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which describes the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tenara]], ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from Korphir used hidden vaults to store their stolen loot.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Tenara system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
